fusions.name: Hold for the Pack
fusions.desc: Catches the target and holds it open, dealing 28 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Lockjaw
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 25% for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Short Leash
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds. For 8 seconds an escort fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lurcher at Heel
fusions.desc: A bonded hound runs with you, striking enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.1 seconds. Anything it bites moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
